messages.content: You are an SRE assistant summarizing incidents.

Incident INC-2026-0814-IOS affected zh-CN→en-US streaming. p95 latency jumped from 640ms to 2,850ms after release 6.4.1. Affected sessions: 12,088. Root cause: client disabled partial_flush and batched 12 chunks before rendering. Mitigation: hotfix 6.4.2 re-enabled partial_flush and reduced chunk_batch_size to 3. Owner: Ana Gomez. Follow-up due 2026-08-16: add synthetic test if p95_stream_latency > 900ms for 5 minutes.
iOS streaming incident: 6.4.1 regression, p95 2,850ms, 12,088 sessions, partial_flush disabled, hotfix 6.4.2, Ana owner.
